name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Strong Republican district (R+11 PVI) with incumbent Keith Self running
Polymarket prices Self at 94% to win
Hunt's modest fundraising ($447K) insufficient to shift the race
No public polling; forecast rests on fundamentals
model.rationale: The baseline of R+14 fits an R+11 district with a first-term incumbent and a well-funded but outmatched challenger; prediction markets agree at ~94% Republican. I nudge slightly toward the Democrats only for the favorable national environment, keeping the race Likely R.
model.watch: A major outside-spending surge for Hunt or a polling shock showing Self under 55% would warrant moving toward Lean R.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Texas's 3rd District, in suburban Collin County, leans Republican by about 11 points, and first-term incumbent Keith Self is seeking reelection after easily securing his party's nomination. His challenger, Democrat Evan Hunt, has raised a respectable $447,000 but trails Self in cash on hand and has no significant outside support, while Self benefits from modest outside backing.
